artifacts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Xiaohongshu English-learning cover, page 1 of 5, vertical 3:4
Primary request: Create one photorealistic overhead photo of a real handwritten study-notebook page. Match the inspected 20260918 reference's tactile handmade feel: pale cream ruled paper, a narrow warm wood desk edge, soft natural window light, clear natural blue-black pen handwriting, sparse pale sage-green and soft-yellow underline accents. This page starts a separate five-page set.
Scene/backdrop: one open cream lined notebook sheet almost filling the frame. At the bottom, two small side-by-side blue-ballpoint doodles: a restaurant bill folder on the left and a simple cup of tea on the right. They are visual clues only and do not reveal extra definitions.
Composition/framing: near-overhead vertical 3:4. Complete Chinese hook at top as the first level; complete English A/B on the next level; final short Chinese clue beneath it. Small drawings at bottom. Keep all content within 8% side and 10% bottom safe margins. Clear hierarchy and ample breathing room.
Style/medium: photorealistic notebook photograph, authentic legible handwriting, sparse hand-drawn contours, no dense hatching, no printed poster look.
Lighting/mood: calm natural window daylight with soft shadows.
Color palette: cream paper, blue-black ink, pale sage-green and soft yellow accents only.
Text (verbatim, and no other text):
"都能说“照顾”
换个场景，还一样吗？
take care of / care for
一张账单，一杯茶"
Text accuracy: Every Chinese character, curly quote, punctuation mark, and English word must appear exactly. Spell take care of and care for carefully. No extra text, labels, page numbers, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
Constraints: Chinese hook is first and complete, full English A/B is second. No writing on the illustrated bill or cup. Exact 3:4 portrait.
artifacts.inspection: 实图通过：逐字准确；中文钩子与英文 A/B 层级清楚；账单和茶杯线稿准确；安全区与3:4通过。

artifacts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Xiaohongshu English-learning page 2 of 5, vertical 3:4
Primary request: A photorealistic near-overhead photograph of a real cream ruled notebook page continuing the 20260920 cover's handmade style: clear natural blue-black handwriting, sparse pale sage-green and soft-yellow underlines, soft natural window light, narrow warm wood desk edge.
Scene/backdrop: One unified small blue-ballpoint doodle in the lower third: the same adult woman sits beside her grandmother on a sofa and gently hands her a simple folded blanket. It is one warm everyday caregiving scene; the two English sentences are both natural descriptions of the same scene, not opposites.
Composition/framing: Heading at top. Two English sentences below as large readable lines, followed by the Chinese sentence and usage note. Supporting scene stays in the lower third, leaving generous white paper space. Keep all content within 8% side and 10% bottom safe margins.
Style/medium: authentic photographed handwritten study note. The illustration must be a simple sparse doodle with open contours and very few interior marks, like a quick ballpoint sketch. Absolutely no cross-hatching, dense parallel shading, photorealistic portrait rendering, fabric texture, floral patterns, or detailed room decor.
Text (verbatim, no other text):
"照顾人：两种都成立
She takes care of her grandmother.
She cares for her grandmother.
她照顾奶奶。
日常表达中，take care of 更常见。"
Text accuracy: render every Chinese character, capital, period, and word exactly. Spell grandmother, takes, cares correctly. No labels, page numbers, logos, signatures, watermarks, or text in the drawing.
Constraints: exact 3:4 portrait; cream paper, blue-black ink, only pale green/yellow accents; simple sparse line art is mandatory.
artifacts.inspection: 修正后实图通过：逐字准确；同一照护场景表达两句重叠含义；已去除首稿的密集排线，线稿简洁。

artifacts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Xiaohongshu English-learning page 3 of 5, vertical 3:4
Primary request: A photorealistic overhead notebook photograph continuing the 20260920 cover style: pale cream ruled paper, natural blue-black handwriting, a narrow wood edge, soft window daylight, sparse pale sage-green and soft-yellow underlines.
Scene/backdrop: A single dining-table setting split into two simple blue-ballpoint moments with consistent viewpoint and objects: left, a hand takes responsibility for the restaurant bill; right, a host offers a teapot to a guest. Simple open contours, no dense hatching.
Composition/framing: Heading at top. First English sentence and its Chinese explanation by the bill scene. Second English question and its Chinese explanation by the tea scene. Final boundary sentence at bottom. Maintain large mobile-readable writing and 8% side / 10% bottom safe margins.
Style/medium: authentic handwritten study-notebook photo, not a printed poster.
Text (verbatim, no other text):
"别把每个 care 都译成照顾
I'll take care of the bill.
账单我来处理。
Would you care for some tea?
您想来点茶吗？
照顾义可重叠；这些用法要看语境。"
Text accuracy: exact apostrophe in I'll, capitals, periods, question mark, semicolon, Chinese. Spell every English word exactly. No extra text anywhere.
Constraints: exact 3:4 portrait; cream paper, blue-black ink, only pale green/yellow accents; no logos, signatures, page numbers, or watermarks.
artifacts.inspection: 实图通过：账单与邀茶两组例句逐字准确；两场景语义清楚；重叠边界完整。

artifacts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Xiaohongshu English-learning self-test, page 4 of 5, vertical 3:4
Primary request: A photorealistic near-overhead photo of a cream ruled notebook page continuing the 20260920 cover style: natural blue-black handwriting, sparse pale sage-green and soft-yellow decorative underlines only, soft window light, narrow warm wood desk edge.
Scene/backdrop: Two equally weighted simple blue-ballpoint scenes. Upper: an order parcel beside a phone showing a complaint/feedback state using shapes only and no screen text. Lower: a host holding a coffee pot toward a guest. Keep line style, viewpoint and people consistent.
Composition/framing: Heading and option line at top. Question 1 with the full Chinese context and English sentence next to the upper scene. Question 2 with the full context and English question next to lower scene. Allow line wrapping, use large readable handwriting, and keep all content within 8% side and 10% bottom safe margins.
Style/medium: authentic photographed handwritten notes; clean open contours, no dense hatching.
Text (verbatim, no other text):
"换个场景，选词填空
选项：take care of / care for
1. 订单出了问题，你表示会处理：
Don't worry. I'll ___ it.
2. 主人礼貌问客人是否想喝咖啡：
Would you ___ some coffee?"
Text accuracy: exact Chinese, apostrophes, underscores, capitals, punctuation and English spelling. No other text anywhere.
Critical self-test constraint: Do not reveal or hint at answers. The two options must have identical ink color, size, weight and underline treatment. No checkmarks, crosses, answer highlights, arrows to choices, circles, or unequal emphasis.
Constraints: exact 3:4 portrait; cream lined paper, blue-black ink, only pale green/yellow accents; no page number, logo, signature, or watermark.
artifacts.inspection: 实图通过：题目与选项逐字准确；两个选项同色同权重；无答案、勾叉或高亮暗示。

artifacts.prompt:
Use case: text-localization
Asset type: Xiaohongshu English-learning answer page, page 5 of 5, vertical 3:4
Input image: supplied 20260920 page 4, edit target and exact visual/layout reference.
Primary request: Make the answer-reveal version of this same notebook. Preserve the same cream ruled paper, narrow wood edge, natural window light, camera angle, crop, two-section layout, upper order parcel and phone feedback scene, and lower host with coffee pot and seated guest. Preserve the same people, poses, objects, blue-ballpoint line art, handwriting feel, and pale green/yellow accent system. Replace all existing written content with only the exact answer copy below; add subtle pale highlights to answer phrases.
Text (verbatim, no other text):
"答案与判断点
1. Don't worry. I'll take care of it.
这里是处理订单问题。
2. Would you care for some coffee?
这里礼貌询问“想要吗”。
说照顾人时，两者可以重叠。"
Text accuracy: exact apostrophes, capitals, periods, question mark, Chinese curly quotation marks and all English words. Remove all old self-test wording, blanks and option line. No extra text anywhere, including the phone. No page numbers, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
Composition: heading at top; answer 1 and its reason with upper parcel/phone scene; answer 2 and its reason with lower coffee-offer scene; overlap boundary line at bottom inside 10% safe margin. Keep 8% side safe margins and exact 3:4 portrait.
artifacts.inspection: 实图通过：答案、理由和重叠边界逐字准确；包裹/手机与咖啡场景、人物、机位和裁切继承图4。

revision_note: 图2首稿文字正确，但人物和毯子排线过密；已定向重生成稀疏开放线稿并用修正版覆盖最终PNG。图5首次并行编辑因网络错误未产出，拆分单张后成功。
